#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int countEvenRuns(const std::string& s, int idx) {
    if (idx >= (int)s.length()) return 0;
    int end = idx;
    while (end < (int)s.length() && s[end] == s[idx]) end++;
    int runLen = end - idx;
    int add = (runLen % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0;
    return add + countEvenRuns(s, end);
}

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::cin >> str;
    std::cout << countEvenRuns(str, 0) << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
